aoi: Egypt Nile Delta exact 3x3 km UTM square
nearest_s2_date_per_field: nearest valid field observation within max_days
footprint_note: EMIT exported raster contains complete AOI UTM square bounding box
cautions: EMIT and Sentinel-2 observations are not simultaneous. Signed date gaps are retained.
EMIT 60m and Sentinel-2 20m sensor resolutions differ; descriptive indices are not directly calibrated.
Sentinel indices and environmental data belong to S2 date, not EMIT date.
s2_split_recorded preserves historical input split only; field_split from audited GeoJSON is authoritative for this comparison.
FTW boundaries are predicted, not authoritative field-survey ground truth.
Fields outside spatial QA train/validation/test selection are excluded, including oversized field 1665168.
Spectral medians are descriptive and bandwise valid-counts may vary.
No independent dust/drought labels. No crop-damage diagnostic accuracy claimed.
Source provenance is Earth Engine export metadata, not an independently downloaded NASA checksum.
